statement:
The record shows invoice 88412 has a payment history of being paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291, despite a current status of unpaid/due.
Invoice 88412 has been placed on hold because the record shows it was already paid in full on 3 September.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the invoice "was already paid in full on 3 September," contradicting the "unpaid, due" status and placing it on hold rather than paying.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
